text.p: Shares in Hungarian plastics industrial group Pannonplast Rt and home improvement product maker group Graboplast rallied to new record highs on Tuesday, fuelled by expectations of strong H1 figures.
"I think people are looking forward to strong first half earnings," one trader said.
Hungarian bourse-listed companies have to submit their first half results to the bourse by August 15 and Pannonplast has traditionally been among the first to do so.
The trader added that the stocks also benefited from tight supply.
Graboplast firmed almost six percent to a new high of 11,600 forints, but slipped back and at 1020 GMT stood at 11,500 forints, up 540 from Monday's close.
Pannonplast firmed to a new high of 10,250 forints, but later retreated and at 1020 GMT traded at 10,175 forints, up 175 from Monday's close.
